'''Fried Endorian chicken''' was a type of [[Foodstuff|fried food]] made from [[Tip-yip|Endorian chicken]],<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> a [[Sentience|non-sentient]] [[bird]] found on the [[forest]] [[moon]] [[Endor]].<ref name="Caravan of Courage">''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref> The chicken was prepared by dipping the meat in [[pom seed flour]] then flash-frying it in hot [[aola]]. Four pieces of fried Endorian chicken were served as a dish at [[Dex's Diner|Dex's Diner]], a [[restaurant]] operated by the [[Besalisk]] [[chef]] [[Dexter Jettster]],<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant|Coruscant]]. The diner's sold the chicken as part of its dinner favorites for 7.9 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> 

==Behind the scenes==
Fried Endorian chicken was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
